summary: No Blocker. The Phase 10 code obeys H2 to H9 for the shipped data, and the plan claims of Red 1, Green 1, Red 2, and Green 2 match their captures. Three Major findings need a disposition before the Maker task. F1: the Maker commit will break R2-6 of storytime-package-family.test.ts, and the Forge commit will break R2-6 and R2-9, but the Maker change list does not name that file. F2: no test checks the H6 facts of a card or Forge JPEG. F3: R2-9 checks the skip line only when a line prints. Six Nit findings follow. The reviewer could not run the GREEN command, because the harness refused every shell call after the first two.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] review-a: Section C. Location: dashboard/__tests__/storytime-package-family.test.ts:1032-1092 (R2-6) and :1129-1160 (R2-9); plan.md, the Red 2 grep evidence and the Maker task line. R2-6 copies the shipped w01.json and expects 6 removed lines and 12 added lines. After the Maker commit (w01 with --partial), the shipped w01 already holds 5 family file lines, so the run adds only the friend line (removed 1, added 2), and R2-6 fails. After the Forge commit, the copy holds 6 file lines (removed 0), and R2-6 fails again. At the Forge commit R2-9 also fails: the partial run keeps the existing friend line, so the week file holds 6 file lines and not 5. The file is in GREEN_TEST_COMMAND and in the storytime-*.test.ts glob of PROJECT_TESTS of the print and loops tracks, so the break reaches three tracks. The P3 grep list names 9 files but does not evaluate this file. Fix: make R2-6 and R2-9 start from a week text with no family file line (for example `git show bbfd25b8:content/storytime/l2/w01.json`, or remove the family file lines and the caption commas from the temporary copy), or add the file to the Maker change list with the same fix.

F2 [Major] review-a: Section A. Location: dashboard/scripts/storytime/set-family-pictures.ts:346-356 (encodePngSource); dashboard/__tests__/storytime-package-family.test.ts:1004-1030 (R2-5). No test checks the H6 facts of a card or Forge output: 800 x 800 px, progressive, sRGB, 4:2:0, no metadata, and 150 KB or less. R2-5 checks only the output hash and the quality range, and checkJpeg of the raster file reads only renderFamilyCardJpeg output. By inspection, a mutant that removes the resize or `progressive: true` in encodePngSource passes the suite, and sections 5.5 and 5.7 hold no such mutant. These outputs are 34 of the 51 pictures, and the Maker commits 15 card JPEGs before the AC10-2 shipped case exists. The current code is correct by inspection. Fix: add the checkJpeg list of R1-7 to R2-5 for each card and Forge JPEG, and add one mutant of encodePngSource to the record.

F3 [Major] review-a: Section A (vacuous pass, A4 class). Location: dashboard/__tests__/storytime-package-family.test.ts:1139-1141 (R2-9). The skip line `skip friend: no Forge file` is checked only inside `if (printed.trim().length > 0)`, so the assertion passes for code that prints nothing. spec.md line 311 and the R2-9 row of test-strategy.md section 5.6 say that --partial prints `skip <word>: no Forge file`. Fix: assert the skip line with no condition.

F4 [Nit] review-a: Section A. Location: dashboard/__tests__/storytime-package-family.test.ts:830-844 (R2-7 case j). The hostile case puts two hostile names (`../x.png` and a name with a space) in one fixture and accepts a union of all rule tokens, with no expected name. A narrow mutant that accepts folder parts but refuses spaces passes, because the space name still throws. G2-M20 removed the whole rule, so it was caught. Fix: split the case into one case for each hostile name, each with the name in `names`.

F5 [Nit] review-a: Section A. Location: dashboard/__tests__/storytime-package-family.test.ts:1004-1030. No case asserts the H7 sort order of the provenance lines. G2-M8 is caught only because R2-10 changes the line order between two runs. Section 5.7 names R2-5 as a detector, but R2-5 does not read the order. Fix: assert in R2-5 that the output paths are sorted, as storytime-book-pictures.test.ts:92 does.

F6 [Nit] review-a: Section A (code, latent). Location: dashboard/scripts/storytime/set-family-pictures.ts:283-319 and :557-580. editFamilyBlock writes the caption as `JSON.stringify(caption[2])`, but caption[2] is raw JSON text, so a caption with an escape (`\"`, `\\`, `\u`) gets a second escape. A caption line that ends with a comma gets a file line with no comma, and the result is not valid JSON. The script does not parse the new text before the write. All 51 shipped captions are plain lower-case words and the last key of the image object, so no shipped week is affected. A unit 2 run can be affected. Fix: keep caption[2] as written, move caption[3] to the file line, and parse the new text with JSON.parse and StorytimeWeekSchema before the first write.

F7 [Nit] review-a: Section A (code). Location: dashboard/scripts/storytime/set-family-pictures.ts:72-83. RULE_TOKENS holds `-line- name`, but no code path throws it, and it holds two forms of one rule (`two color files`, `2 color files`). Spec H3 says that a `-line-` name stops the script. The code ignores a line file, and a word with only a line file fails with `no color file` (R2-7 case h, R2-8). The behavior matches the test strategy, but the token list does not match the code. Fix: remove the unused tokens, or record in H3 that the stop has the token `no color file`.

F8 [Nit] review-a: Section B. Location: dashboard/scripts/storytime/set-family-pictures.ts:483-489. The scan for unlisted color files runs on the card folder only. In the Forge folder, an unlisted color file of the requested word gives `not in MANIFEST` or `2 color files`, but an unlisted color file of another word or week causes no error. Step 1 of the Forge pre-check in the plan (`comm` of the MANIFEST names and the PNG names) covers this by hand. Fix: run unlistedColorFiles on the Forge folder too, or record the pre-check as the control.

F9 [Nit] review-a: Section C. Location: plan.md, the Maker and Forge delivery task lines. The PROJECT_CHECKS of the print track, the unit 2 track, and the cover-options track run check-weeks, which exits 1 on any FAIL row. A family-pictures FAIL occurs when a week file names a JPEG that is not in the work tree, so a content commit that holds the week file but not its new `family/` folder breaks those three gates. Recommend: the scope guard of each content commit lists `content/storytime/l2/media/w0N/family/*.jpg` and `pictures.sha256` next to the week file, and the role runs check-weeks after it stages the files.
evidence: Scope of the commits: ae68a01f holds only storytime-package-raster.test.ts; ad767a78 holds family-pictures.ts and set-family-pictures.ts; 1fb10d7d, 1af1bc15, and 680ec458 hold only storytime-package-family.test.ts; 1a3a38ed holds only set-family-pictures.ts and check-weeks.ts.

Section A, mutants: p10-green2-mutants.txt gives `mutants: 20, caught: 20`, `survivors: none`, and `restore cmp: all equal`. The plan lists the G1 detectors, with G1-M1 caught by R1-2 only, and records the rewrite of G2-M1 and G2-M10.

Section A, Red defect class: the reviewer read all 27 cases of storytime-package-family.test.ts and all 15 cases of storytime-package-raster.test.ts. No other assertion fails for every implementation. The assertions that can pass for any code are F3 (a condition on the assertion) and, less strongly, F4 (a broad token). The raster checks (checkJpeg, the pixel probes of R1-8 and R1-9, and the dot counts of R1-10) read real Chrome output and have fixed expected values.

Section A, plan claims (A5): p10-green2-green.txt gives `Test Files 3 passed (3)` and `exit: 0`; p10-green2-project.txt gives `Test Files 61 passed (61)` and `exit: 0`; p10-green2-checks.txt gives `Summary: 8 package(s), 0 failed check(s), 16 warning(s).` and `exit: 0`; p10-green2-lint.txt gives `exit: 0`; p10-green2-live.txt gives 7 WARN family-pictures rows, 0 FAIL rows, no st2/8 row, 5 ok lines, the friend line `no color file`, and 0 content changes. Each value agrees with the Green 2 task line.

Section B, paths: readManifest refuses every name outside `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$` and the names `.` and `..` before any read; storytimeFamilyPicturePath refuses a word outside `^[a-z]+$` and a week outside 1 to 99; main limits level to 1 to 4 and week to 1 to 99 and fixes the content root to STORYTIME_ROOT. A symlink in a source folder is followed, but the file SHA-256 must equal the MANIFEST line, so the bytes stay pinned. The adversarial round covers symlinks.

Section B, HTML escape: esc escapes &, <, >, and " in the data-card-patch attribute and the page title; R1-5 and G1-M9 cover it. The patch hex goes into the markup without escape, but it comes from the code constant STORYTIME_CARD_COLOR_PATCH.
Section B, source PNG: `git ls-files` shows no family or card PNG; no `family/` media folder is committed at this HEAD.

Section C, receiver contract (read-only): apps/storytime/lib/contracts/week.ts:78-85 gives image.file as an optional mediaPath (allowlist, at most 200 characters, no `.` or `..` segment); `l2/media/w0N/family/<word>.jpg` fits it. receive-weeks.ts:121-128 lists each family word picture with rule 9.1, and :180 accepts `.jpg`. A family word with an image and no file is a missing picture, not an error. No contract change is necessary.

Section C, H12: the revision folders are built by the Package build task; no code of this phase implements H12, so no H12 code is audited here. The nine checks of section 5.11 stay the acceptance test of that task.

Section C, tests of other tracks that read week files (P3 grep, 9 files plus the Phase 10 files): storytime-loops-content.test.ts breaks for each changed week, because withoutNewFields (lines 403-408) removes book.cover.file and page.image.file but not focus.family.words[].image.file; fix: delete word.image?.file for each family word. storytime-print-v15.test.ts breaks in AX-lines (line 252): the 5 pinned lines 2094, 4119, 4147, 4153, and 4205 of w02.json lie after the family block, and w02 gains 10 lines, so the pins become 2104, 4129, 4157, 4163, and 4215. No change: storytime-book-pictures (reads books only, line 78), storytime-print-covers-16books and its adversarial file (read words only), storytime-manual (family name only), storytime-week (fixture week), storytime-print-e4-back-list (words only), storytime-package-raster (no week file). storytime-package-family breaks as F1 states.

Section C, PROJECT_CHECKS: the new check returns warn, never fail, while a word has no file (H9; check-weeks.ts:41-51), and the live run gives 0 FAIL rows, so the print, loops, unit 2, and cover-options gates stay green at this HEAD. F9 names the one way that a later content commit can give a FAIL row.
commands: NOT RUN: the GREEN_TEST_COMMAND in one heavy-run wrapper. The harness refused the shell call with `Permission denied: shell` (two attempts). The reviewer used the Green 2 capture p10-green2-green.txt instead.
